blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Make the current combat slice visibly trustworthy by restoring whole-package first-person and enemy animation bindings, enabling route-independent qualification of their real runtime states, replacing the unresolved movement-audio strategy with contact-aligned decoded playback, and isolating the daylight highlight defect without disturbing the authored arena or its accepted atmosphere stack.

diagnosis.root_cause: The selected failures are integration and runtime-qualification defects rather than missing packages. The intact AK-74M rig is present, but its product binding does not preserve credible support-hand contact; enemy rifle actions and upright-root behavior cannot be qualified through the blocked route. Audio still relies on quiet retained movement recordings without listener-mix proof, while repeated global daylight tuning has not isolated the material-response cause of clipped highlights. The authored environment and its accepted atmosphere layers must remain intact.

stop_conditions: Stop and preserve the current package if a proposed animation repair requires editing, hiding, detaching, or independently transforming authored gun, hand, skeleton, mesh, or map children.
Do not bypass, reorder, or falsify A/B/C mission progression to obtain animation evidence; use presentation-neutral observation or a bounded qualification path that owns no mission truth.

If mixed-output capture or audition remains unavailable, retain finding.footstep-long-stream-restart as insufficient evidence and do not claim audio acceptance from stream paths, receipts, or playing=true.

Do not continue broad exposure or brightness tuning if matched material-isolation probes cannot identify the highlight cause without removing the accepted sky, shadows, SSAO, cloud sheets, or directional flare.
Stop on candidate script/resource errors, failed clean boot, broken imported-resource bindings, duplicate player Foley owners, or lifecycle state that only recovers after restarting Godot.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy after repeated attempts: restore direct component/profile and authority-to-animation bindings instead of descendant transform tuning; add bounded observation where progression blocks evidence; replace the long-stream movement-audio approach atomically instead of adjusting it again; and isolate renderer/material response before changing daylight values. This preserves the accepted viewmodel, authored Standoff Arena instance, and distinct atmosphere layers.

code: Run the pinned Godot import/clean-boot check and parse every changed script, scene, profile, audio binding, and environment resource without candidate errors or missing dependencies.

Source-audit the runtime viewmodel hierarchy for one coupled package and no descendant compensation; audit enemy state mappings for authority-driven rifle semantics and yaw-only navigation-root ownership.

Enumerate player and enemy Foley creation/playback sites and fail duplicate player owners, AudioStreamGenerator/noise movement placeholders, per-contact restarts of long recordings, unbounded emitters, or missing cleanup.

Compare the changed environment resources with the preserved layer contract; fail authored-map child edits, map duplication/replacement, proxy road/floor additions, or a single global brightness change presented as material isolation.
runtime: Host/Tester: from authoritative gameplay with captured mouse and advancing game time, record AK-74M hip, ADS-settled, AUTO fire peaks and release recovery, tactical/empty reload contact, inspect, switch, pause/resume, Home-new mission, checkpoint restore, Replay, and F6 reset; pair each state with hierarchy, clip, transform, hand/socket, recoil, input, ammo, and late-log receipts.

Host/Tester: sample representative active enemies in adjacent early/middle/action frames for search, locomotion, aim, accepted fire, reload, hurt, death, restore, and Replay. Bind stable ID, region, weapon family, semantic/clip, normalized time, velocity, grounded/alive state, root pitch/roll, presentation-axis correction, shot/reload event, and hand/weapon attachment. Use the bounded observer if.
visual: Host/Tester: capture matched 16:9 AK-74M hip, ADS, fire peak/recovery, and reload-contact frames; require visible two-hand contact, readable muzzle/optic direction, plausible scale, and no near-plane, wrist, arm-back, or HUD clipping.

Host/Tester: capture first-person plus defect-focused enemy frames during planted locomotion, search turn, aim/fire, reload, hurt, and death; reject pistol/prone/death clips on living rifle actors, sliding, root tilt, floating weapons, detached contacts, or death motion continuing after authority shutdown.

Host/Tester: capture matched deployment and critical-route daylight frames of directly lit plaster, corrugated metal, and concrete with exposure/sky/shadows/SSAO/clouds/flare reported separately; require retained material detail and no fog/darkness used to conceal the arena.

Compare deployment and critical-route composition with the bound visual reference while preserving the intact authored environment; report remaining industrial-density mismatch under fp.release.visual-reference-industrial-density rather than adding proxy clutter.

done_when: AK-74M hip, settled ADS, fire peak, recoil recovery, tactical reload, empty reload, inspect, and switch states use one intact gun/hands/skeleton/AnimationLibrary hierarchy, with both hands contacting plausible authored support points and no per-child compensation.

The direct component profile and product adapter have explicit ownership: source-axis correction remains fixed, product recoil remains additive, and Home, Replay, checkpoint restore, pause, death, defusal, reload interruption, and weapon switching cancel transients back to the authored Hip/ADS baseline.

Enemy navigation roots own yaw only and remain upright through idle, search, movement, aim, fire, reload, hurt, death, checkpoint restore, Replay, and fresh deployment; pitch is confined to the presentation upper-body layer.

Accepted enemy shot and reload authority drives distinct rifle-compatible presentation semantics with stable actor ID, weapon family, clip/overlay state, normalized time, velocity, grounded/alive state, socket/contact state, and action milestones observable in adjacent samples.

A bounded presentation-neutral qualification record can expose the real AK-74M and enemy state cells even when ordinary regional progression remains route-blocked; it neither mutates mission authority nor substitutes preview clips for production bindings.

A regression patrol preserves Saiga-12 framing, mouse look during sustained fire, recoil return, ballistic/reticle agreement, enemy occupancy/occlusion, reload/F6 separation, and clean late runtime logs.
tasks.instructions: Repair the animation surface through direct instance/profile and authority-binding restoration. First compare the currently instantiated AK-74M hierarchy with its materialized component scene and profile, then remove or correct only product-owned adapter/binding divergence. Preserve the coupled gun, hands, skeleton, meshes, AnimationLibrary, supplied clips, authored profile values, and camera-relative package; do not tune descendants. For enemies, bind navigation velocity, visibility/facing, accepted shot, magazine reload, damage, lethal state, and restore lifecycle directly to rifle-compatible states while keeping root pitch/roll locked and aim pitch on the presentation layer. Extend existing observation/qualification output only as needed to retain adjacent state evidence when the deferred route blocker prevents ordinary B/C traversal; do not create a second gameplay authority or a manual preview pass. Keep telemetry compact and actor-bound.

Idle, ordinary walk, sprint, crouch, landing, and representative enemy movement expose source duration, waveform/loudness class, gain, pitch, spatial attenuation, every bus/master stage, competing active stream inventory, and resulting effective listener gain for fresh mixed-output comparison.

Ordinary movement produces naturally audible, cadence-aligned contacts without the reported buzz, hum, substitute cue, or masked -42 dBFS-style playback; enemy contacts remain spatial, non-looping, actor-owned, grounded, and bounded to one emitter per actor.

The intact authored Standoff Arena instance, native streets/buildings/props, human scale, collision/navigation datum, selected daylight/exposure, source sky, shadows, SSAO, two cloud sheets, and camera/sun-bound directional flare remain separately bound and observable.

No proxy floor, facade slice, backdrop, decorative clutter suite, authored-child edits, or map replacement is introduced.
